stabilization.boundary: Deterministic GPU histories, current geometry and actual SM307 producer; no human visual approval or whole-game throughput claim.

memory.boundary: Renderer-owned descriptor estimates, excluding shared fixture/G-buffer/hierarchy, driver allocations and observer query/readback buffers; not measured resident VRAM.
Renderer-owned descriptor estimates, excluding shared fixture/G-buffer/hierarchy, driver allocations and observer query/readback buffers; not measured resident VRAM.

timingSemantics.gpuMs: legacy alias of queueSpanGpuMs; retained for report compatibility
timingSemantics.queueSpanGpuMs: GPU timestamp span from a marker submitted before the async pass callback until a marker submitted after it returns; includes queued GPU work and may include GPU-idle time caused by host waits before the ending marker is submitted
timingSemantics.commandGpuMs: sum of explicitly bracketed command-buffer submissions made through performanceTimingScope.submit(); each start/work/end sequence is submitted atomically to the queue and excludes host gaps between submit calls
timingSemantics.hostWaitMs: explicit host-side waits recorded through performanceTimingScope.recordHostWait()/measureHostWait(); never a GPU-time substitute
timingSemantics.readbackMapLatencyMs: wall-clock latency of SM-500 timestamp readback mapAsync; diagnostic transport latency, not GPU execution time

timing.boundary: Paired/interleaved same-quality fixed synthetic native1920x1080,pixelScale3. Primary gpuMs is SM500 explicit complete producer command span (trace,resolve,compose,snapshot). Direct pass queries are separate observers. Shared hierarchy/input uploads, all output/observer maps and query resolves are excluded. Callback queue spans may include host gaps. Descriptor memory is estimated owned allocation size, not resident VRAM. This is SSGI cost characterization, not full-game/renderer throughput.
